name: [Class] An Adventurer from Another Time and Space

steps.name: [Class] An Adventurer from Another Time and Space

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Recently, some unusual data has been flowing into the Hyperspace Network.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The network identifies it as data generated by you, Adventurer, yet some of it does not belong to the adventurer I know...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I believe these are traces of you from different worlds, with different memories. Instability in the Hyperspace Network seems to have caused several unusual phenomena.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: When another adventurer does something, it remains as a record that you can view. Likewise, when you do something, another adventurer will be able to view that record...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a little hard to follow.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You may not understand at first... but you'll get used to it. From now on, all your records will appear beneath your current chapter.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: A unit of a story. Please take a look whenever new data is discovered.
